title: 演化日誌預設只顯示真實演化歷史，自動提案收進可展開的彙總

delivered: Extended paths.mgmtEvolutionJournal in src/lib/bff-v1/paths.ts to support view ('all' | 'history' | 'auto_proposals'), pageSize (page_size), and pageToken (page_token) alongside persona, mutationReview (mutation_review), and decision.
Updated queryKeys.oversight.evolutionJournal in src/lib/bff-v1/queryKeys.ts to accept an optional view/filter key while preserving backward compatibility when called with only a scope.

Added adaptEvolutionJournalList<T> and typed EvolutionJournalList<T> in src/lib/bff-v1/management.ts (reusing the existing mgmt.evolutionJournal.list method without adding a second client or store) to preserve array row access while attaching summary, auto_proposal_counts / autoProposalCounts, page_info / pageInfo, and meta from the BFF /bff/management/evolution-journal response.
Extended normalizeEvolutionHref in src/lib/bff-v1/management.ts to validate optional view query parameters ('all', 'history', 'auto_proposals').

Added normalizeEvolutionJournalView (defaulting to 'history') and extended EvolutionJournalEntry / evolutionEntryText in src/management/pages/oversight/evolutionJournalFocus.ts to index evidence_class, persona_id, route, decision, mutation_review, and record fields so filterEvolutionJournalRowsForFocus matches deep links across all real BFF shapes.

Updated EvolutionJournalPage in src/management/pages/oversight/_core.tsx to: (1) request view=history by default and reflect filtered summary and page_info pagination; (2) render the auto_proposal_counts summary line (total, incident_followup, incident_severity, postmortem_draft) in both locales with a control that switches between view=auto_proposals and view=history while persisting view in the URL; (3) render the empty-history state when view=history is empty stating no evolution has been executed yet and how many automatic proposals are waiting; (4) render evidence_class badges and metadata fields on journal rows so incident_followup and incident_severity are distinguishable from threshold_signal; (5) render the degraded error state on failed or surface-degraded reads and never show the empty history text when a read fails.

Added symmetric en-US and zh-TW locale keys under mgmt.evolution.* in src/i18n/locales/en-US.ts and src/i18n/locales/zh-TW.ts and verified 1:1 parity in src/lib/v5/management/__tests__/i18nParity.test.ts.

Updated e2e/evochain009.spec.ts, e2e/25-persona-fleet-live-linked-pages.spec.ts, and e2e/24-persona-fleet-click-map.spec.ts to align with view=history default, auto_proposal_counts summary, and evidence_class rendering.
not_changing: Pantheon BFF / owner services (already delivered in EVOLUTION-JOURNAL-EVIDENCE-CLASS-20261104).
Hosted environment verification (owned by downstream operator acceptance task EVOLUTION-RESEARCH-HOSTED-ACCEPT-20261104).
